_note: Pointers and paraphrase only - never code or standard text. Editions are not recorded here: the edition is the one the adopted code references. Enforced by kb-lint.py.

standards.title: Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems
standards.governs: Sprinkler design, layout, spacing, obstructions and hydraulic calculation
standards.code_hook: IBC Chapter 9 / IFC require automatic sprinklers to this standard
standards.pm_trigger: Any ceiling, bulkhead, soffit or tall-joinery change; a change of hazard classification from a new use or storage height

standards.title: National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code
standards.governs: Fire alarm, detection and notification - device spacing, audibility and visibility, interfaces
standards.code_hook: IBC/IFC fire alarm sections call it up
standards.pm_trigger: New rooms or partitions, ceiling height changes, a change of use that changes notification requirements

standards.title: National Electrical Code (NEC)
standards.governs: Wiring methods, overcurrent protection, grounding, working clearances
standards.code_hook: Adopted directly by the state or locality, often on its own edition cycle
standards.pm_trigger: Panel changes, new circuits for equipment, working clearance in front of switchboards, emergency and exit lighting circuits

standards.title: Life Safety Code
standards.governs: Means of egress, occupancy-based life-safety features
standards.code_hook: Used instead of or beside the IBC in some jurisdictions and for federally regulated healthcare
standards.pm_trigger: Healthcare or assembly occupancies; a jurisdiction that adopts NFPA 101 for existing buildings

standards.title: Accessible and Usable Buildings and Facilities
standards.governs: Technical accessibility criteria - clear floor spaces, reach ranges, door clearances, accessible toilet rooms
standards.pm_trigger: Counters, door hardware and clearances, toilet room layouts, any change to an accessible route. Check the 2010 ADA Standards separately - they are a different regime

standards.title: Energy Standard for Sites and Buildings Except Low-Rise Residential Buildings
standards.governs: Envelope, HVAC, lighting power and controls energy requirements
standards.code_hook: Accepted by the IECC as an alternative commercial compliance path
standards.pm_trigger: Lighting layouts and controls, HVAC replacement, envelope changes - confirm which path the AHJ accepts

standards.title: Ventilation and Acceptable Indoor Air Quality
standards.governs: Minimum outdoor-air ventilation rates by space type
standards.code_hook: Referenced through the IMC ventilation chapter in many jurisdictions
standards.pm_trigger: Any change of use or occupant density, new rooms, kitchen or exhaust changes

standards.title: Standard Test Methods for Fire Tests of Building Construction and Materials
standards.governs: The fire-resistance test behind rated wall, floor and ceiling assemblies
standards.pm_trigger: Any penetration or alteration of a rated assembly - the tested assembly listing (for example a UL design number) has to match what is built

standards.title: Fire Tests of Building Construction and Materials
standards.governs: UL's equivalent fire-resistance test; listed designs are what drawings cite
standards.pm_trigger: Drawings citing a rated assembly by listing number - confirm the listed design matches the drawn and built assembly

standards.title: Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete
standards.governs: Design and detailing of structural concrete
standards.pm_trigger: Slab penetrations, coring, post-installed anchors into existing slabs, new loads on existing floors

standards.title: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
standards.governs: Design of structural steel members and connections
standards.pm_trigger: New openings in steel framing, hung loads from existing steel, signage and equipment supports
